acceptance_criteria.criterion: #10129 and #10086 are each rebased onto current origin/main and their @go_tag_floor is re-measured by the 999-technique on the merged tree — never by summing.
Each PR's checks are re-fired by a push, and the fact that its previous green predated the census is recorded in the PR body.
A decision is recorded for whether a mechanism should re-fire stale checks when a path set widens, or whether it stays a manual lead act.

content.value: Both PRs add json tag NAMES to internal/cloudclient/client.go and neither touches cloud/test/barkpark_cloud/payload_key_set_census_test.exs: #10129 adds absorption, box_caused, deploy_rate, rate, sites_deploying (+5); #10086 adds details (+1). RUN-PROVED: appending exactly those six names gives '234 json tag(s) found in internal/cloudclient, floor is EXACTLY 228' against an == floor. Both are DIRTY and both conflict IN client.go itself, so 'merge as-is' is not available. THE SHARPEST PART: the census test did not exist when either was last gated — it landed 2026-08-07 10:09 (#10190) and both bases are earlier that day; git show <head>:...census_test.exs returns 'exists on disk, but not in <sha>'. Their frozen greens are green against a tree with NO census at all. AND #10086's Cloud gate reports skipping on a cloudclient change because internal/cloudclient/ was added to CLOUD_PATHS LATER (#10726) — a guard's coverage GREW and nothing re-checked the open PRs frozen under the narrower version. Only a push re-fires. Whoever merges them owns a red main.
